notes.title: Voidreth: Our Sci-Fi Horror Extraction Game Is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p][b]Welcome, explorers and thrill-seekers,[/b][/p][p]Voidreth is entering the final stretch before its Early Access release. Just a few final balance tweaks remain before you can dive into the darkness of our haunted lunar outposts.[/p][p]🗺️ In the coming days, we’ll publish a [b]Roadmap[/b] outlining the next 3 months — including what content, features, and improvements are planned.[/p][p]🧩 Here's what to expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Major content updates:[/b] ~Once per month, usually toward the end of the month[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical bug fixes:[/b] As needed[/p][/*][*][p][b]General improvements & tweaks:[/b] Every two weeks, typically on weekends[/p][/*][/list][p]The roadmap will also allow you to:[/p][list][*][p]Track progress[/p][/*][*][p]Submit bug reports[/p][/*][*][p]Share feedback and suggestions[/p][/*][/list][p]We're incredibly excited to share Voidreth with you and can’t wait to hear your thoughts, ideas, and theories once you start exploring.[/p][p]Stay close — the void is almost ready to be breached.

🎥 [b]Follow us on [/b][url="https://www.youtube.com/@squirrelinteractive"]YouTube[/url][b] and [/b][url="https://www.instagram.com/squirrelinteractive/"]Instagram[/url] for behind-the-scenes content, early gameplay previews, and more updates as we approach release![/p]
